items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: The interviewee discusses a dog named 'Booker T' or 'T.' in the context of feeding it, with no indication of a personal or professional relationship with a person named Booker T.

ctx.x: I'm going to knock all that collie out of me. You won't fool me, you'll tear my thing up. I'm a person.

Booker T, on Booker T, he got a female, you know, and he said she looks more like a collie, so he named a lassie. He said, anybody rings my bell, she answers the door first. And she gets his slippers for him.
And this dog, I got you, he's a little puppy, but he don't chew his food at all. If you put something on your arm, gone. That's gone.
